title: Do small language models know what they don't know?
abstract: arXiv:2609.20824v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We explore whether entropy-based confidence signals can be leveraged to improve the accuracy of Small Language Models (SLMs) with fewer than 3 billion parameters, running entirely on consumer hardware. We evaluate seven distinct approaches, including token-level entropy early stopping, semantic entropy estimation, and uncertainty-aware routing to larger expert models, across 7 model pairs and 5 standard NLU benchmarks. Our key finding is that token-level entropy is effectively blind in SLMs: in 91% of dataset-model combinations, mean token entropy is near zero regardless of answer correctness, rendering token-based confidence signals unusable at this scale. We demonstrate that semantic entropy, computed by generating multiple samples, clustering answers by meaning, and measuring distributional uncertainty, recovers a viable confidence signal. translated_title: 小型语言模型知道自己不知道什么吗？
translated_abstract: 我们探究了基于熵的置信度信号能否用于提升参数量小于30亿、可完全在消费级硬件上运行的小型语言模型（SLM）的准确性。我们在7个模型对和5个标准自然语言理解（NLU）基准上评估了七种不同的方法，包括词元级熵早停、语义熵估计，以及将不确定的查询路由到更大专家模型的不确定性感知机制。我们的关键发现是：词元级熵在小型语言模型中实际上是“失明”的——在91%的数据集-模型组合中，无论答案正确与否，平均词元熵都接近于零，这使得基于词元的置信度信号在该规模下无法使用。我们进一步证明，通过生成多个样本、按语义对答案进行聚类并度量分布不确定性所计算出的语义熵，能够恢复出可行的置信度信号。利用语义熵选择性地将不确定的查询路由到更大的专家模型，能够带来准确率的提升……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文发现词元级熵在小型语言模型中无法区分答案对错，而通过多次采样并按语义聚类计算的语义熵可以恢复可靠的置信度信号，据此将不确定的查询路由给更大的专家模型即可在消费级硬件上提升小模型的回答准确率。
en_tdlr: Token-level entropy is effectively blind in small language models, but semantic entropy computed by sampling multiple answers and clustering them by meaning recovers a usable confidence signal that enables routing uncertain queries to larger expert models to improve accuracy on consumer hardware.
